headline: Revenue growth continues, margins expand, profit accelerates
summary_short: GE HealthCare reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $5,294M, up 5.8% y/y and 3.2% q/q, with net income of $560M (+15.2% y/y) and diluted EPS of $1.24 (+17.0% y/y).
summary_long: Revenue was $5,294M, up 5.8% y/y and 3.2% q/q. Gross margin expanded to about 41.2% of revenue (+156bp y/y, +262bp q/q) on gross profit of $2,179M. Operating income rose to $738M (+13.2% y/y), operating margin up roughly 92bp y/y to 13.9%. Net income reached $560M (+15.2% y/y, +44.0% q/q); diluted EPS was $1.24, up 17.0% y/y and 45.9% q/q.
